SELECT IN_TB.* FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT A.CRM_CODE, A.CUST_CODE, A.CUST_NM, A.CUST_GUBUN, A.FOUNDATION_DT, A.CONTRACT_DT, D.ACTION_RESULT_CODE,
B.OPEN_DT, B.TERM_PERSON_COUNT, B.PM, B.TEST_DT, B.VERSION, B.FORMATION_CODE, B.OS, B.MTAC_CONTRACT_DT, B.CUST_KOR_NAME, B.BASIC_ETC, B.BED_COUNT,
C.DEAL_CODE, C.HIS_BASIC_CODE, C.HIS_TREAT_CODE, C.HIS_WORK_CODE, C.HIS_CLAIM_CODE, C.CHOICE_YN, C.DENTIST_YN, C.MENTAL_YN, C.ORIENTAL_YN, C.HEMODIALYSIS_YN, C.CARE_YN, C.CARE_GRADE, C.OS AS C_OS, G.GUBUN, G.CONTENTS, G.ETC,
B.CUST_GUBUN AS B_CUST_GUBUN, B.VETERANS_YN, B.MILITARY_YN, B.OLD_COMPANY_NM, B.OUTSIDE_CUST_CODE, F.CHARGE_CODE, F.CHARGE_NM, C.VETERANS_YN AS C_VETERANS_YN, C.MILITARY_YN AS C_MILITARY_YN, C.OLD_COMPANY_NM AS C_OLD_COMPANY_NM, C.OUTSIDE_CUST_CODE AS C_OUTSIDE_CUST_CODE, E.CHARGE_CODE AS E_CHARGE_CODE, E.CHARGE_NM AS E_CHARGE_NM,
(SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD01' AND Z.CODE = A.CUST_GUBUN) CUST_GUBUN_NM, (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD14' AND Z.CODE = B.VERSION) VERSION_NM, (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD15' AND Z.CODE = B.FORMATION_CODE) FORMATION_CODE_NM, (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD18' AND Z.CODE = B.OS) OS_NM, (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD26' AND Z.CODE = B.OUTSIDE_CUST_CODE) OUTSIDE_CUST_CODE_NM, (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD27' AND Z.CODE = F.CHARGE_CODE) CHARGE_CODE_NM, (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD03' AND Z.CODE = C.DEAL_CODE) DEAL_CODE_NM, (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD04' AND Z.CODE = C.HIS_BASIC_CODE) HIS_BASIC_CODE_NM, (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD05' AND Z.CODE = C.HIS_TREAT_CODE) HIS_TREAT_CODE_NM, (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD06' AND Z.CODE = C.HIS_WORK_CODE) HIS_WORK_CODE_NM, (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD07' AND Z.CODE = C.HIS_CLAIM_CODE) HIS_CLAIM_CODE_NM, (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD11' AND Z.CODE = D.ACTION_RESULT_CODE) ACTION_RESULT_CODE_NM FROM CRM_CUST_MGT A INNER JOIN CRM_CUST_PROJECT_MGT B ON A.SEQ = B.SEQ INNER JOIN CRM_CUST_OPERATE_INFO C ON B.SEQ = C.SEQ LEFT OUTER JOIN CRM_CUST_MGT_ISSUE D ON A.SEQ = D.SEQ LEFT OUTER JOIN CRM_CUST_OPERATE_CHARGE E ON C.SEQ = E.SEQ LEFT OUTER JOIN CRM_CUST_PROJECT_CHARGE F ON B.SEQ = F.SEQ LEFT OUTER JOIN CRM_CUST_OPERATE_NOTE G ON C.SEQ = G.SEQ ) IN_TB WHERE 1=1
${queryWhere}
ORDER BY IN_TB.CUST_NM ASC

SELECT IN_TB.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER( ORDER BY IN_TB.CUST_KOR_NAME DESC ) AS RNUM FROM ( SELECT -- 관리정보 A.SEQ , -- 번호 A.CUST_ADDRESS , -- 사업자소재지 A.CUST_KOR_NAME , -- 거래처명 A.CRM_CODE , -- crm코드 A.CUST_GUBUN , -- 거래처 구분 코드 DECODE(A.CUST_GUBUN , null , '' , (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD01' AND Z.CODE = A.CUST_GUBUN)) AS CUST_GUBUN_NM , -- 거래처구분 명 A.FOUNDATION_CODE , -- 재단구분코드 DECODE(A.FOUNDATION_CODE , null , '' , (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD08' AND Z.CODE = A.FOUNDATION_CODE)) AS FOUNDATION_CODE_NM , -- 재단구분명 A.FOUNDATION_DT , -- 병원 설립일 A.CONTRACT_DT , -- 계약일자 A.BED_COUNT , -- 병상BED -- 운영정보 B.DEAL_CODE , -- 거래상태 코드 (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD03' AND Z.CODE = B.DEAL_CODE) AS DEAL_CODE_NM , -- 거래상태코드명 B.HIS_BASIC_CODE , -- HIS 기초버전 코드 (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD04' AND Z.CODE = B.HIS_BASIC_CODE) AS HIS_BASIC_CODE_NM , -- HIS기초버전 명 B.HIS_TREAT_CODE , -- HIS 진료버전 코드 (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD05' AND Z.CODE = B.HIS_TREAT_CODE) AS HIS_TREAT_CODE_NM , -- HIS진료버전 명 B.HIS_WORK_CODE , -- HIS 원무버전 코드 (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD06' AND Z.CODE = B.HIS_WORK_CODE) AS HIS_WORK_CODE_NM , -- HIS원무버전 명 B.HIS_CLAIM_CODE , -- HIS 청구버전 코드 (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD07' AND Z.CODE = B.HIS_CLAIM_CODE) AS HIS_CLAIM_CODE_NM , -- HIS청구버전 명 B.SPECIALLY_CODE, -- 전무병원 여부 B.BED_COUNT as O_BED_COUNT, -- 병상 BED B.VETERANS_YN, -- 보훈여부 B.MILITARY_YN, -- 군지역소재 B.CHOICE_YN, -- 선택진료 B.DENTIST_YN, -- 치과유무 B.MENTAL_YN, -- 정신과 B.ORIENTAL_YN, -- 한방 B.HEMODIALYSIS_YN, -- 혈액투석 B.CARE_YN, -- 포괄간호 B.DOCTOR_COUNT, -- 의사수 B.NURSE_COUNT, -- 간호사수 B.CARE_GRADE, -- 간호등급 B.NEW_CODE, -- 신규/기존코드 (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD25' AND Z.CODE = B.NEW_CODE) AS NEW_CODE_NM , -- 신규/기존코드 명 B.OLD_COMPANY_NM, -- 기존전산업체 명 B.COME_COUNT, -- 일평균 내원자수 B.OUTSIDE_CUST_CODE, -- 외부 수탁 업체코드 (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD26' AND Z.CODE = B.OUTSIDE_CUST_CODE) AS OUTSIDE_CUST_CODE_NM , -- 외부 수탁업체명 B.CHARGE_YN, -- 청구여부 B.DETAIL_ETC, -- 특이사항 -- 프로젝트 정보 C.CUST_KOR_NAME AS P_CUST_KOR_NAME, -- 거래처명 C.CRM_CODE AS P_CRM_CODE, -- CRM코드 C.CUST_GUBUN AS P_CUST_GUBUN , -- 거래처 구분 코드 DECODE(A.CUST_GUBUN , null , '' , (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD01' AND Z.CODE = C.CUST_GUBUN)) AS P_CUST_GUBUN_NM , -- 거래처구분 명 C.NEW_CODE AS P_NEW_CODE , -- 신규/기존코드 (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD25' AND Z.CODE = C.NEW_CODE) AS P_NEW_CODE_NM , -- 신규/기존코드 명 C.OLD_COMPANY_NM AS P_OLD_COMPANY_NM , -- 기존전산업체 명 C.SPECIALLY_CODE AS P_SPECIALLY_CODE , -- 전무병원 여부 C.VERSION , -- PJT OCS/EMR ver C.PM , -- PM C.ADDR , -- 주소 C.TREAT_NO , -- 요양기관기호 C.CUST_NO , -- 사업자번호 C.DOCTOR_COUNT AS P_DOCTOR_COUNT, -- 의사수 C.BED_COUNT AS P_BED_COUNT, -- 병상 BED C.TERM_START_DT, -- 투입기간1 C.TERM_END_DT, -- 투입기간2 C.OPEN_DT, -- 전산오픈일 C.TEST_DT, -- 최종검수일 C.FORMATION_CODE , -- 구성 (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD15' AND Z.CODE = C.FORMATION_CODE) AS FORMATION_CODE_NM , -- 구성 명 C.SERVER_CODE , -- 서버 제조사/모델 코드 (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD16' AND Z.CODE = C.SERVER_CODE) AS SERVER_CODE_NM , -- 서버 제조사/모델 코드 C.OS , -- OS 코드 (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD18' AND Z.CODE = C.OS) AS OS_NM , -- OS 명 C.RAM , -- 서버RAM 코드 (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD19' AND Z.CODE = C.RAM) AS RAM_NM , -- RAM 명 C.PC , -- PC C.ORACLE_VERSION , -- 오라클 버전 (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD21' AND Z.CODE = C.ORACLE_VERSION) AS ORACLE_VERSION_NM , -- 오라클 버전 명 C.OUTSIDE_CUST_CODE AS P_OUTSIDE_CUST_CODE, -- 외부 수탁 업체코드 (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD26' AND Z.CODE = C.OUTSIDE_CUST_CODE) AS P_OUTSIDE_CUST_CODE_NM , -- 외부 수탁업체명 C.BASIC_ETC AS P_BASIC_ETC, -- 기타설명 C.DETAIL_ETC AS P_DETAIL_ETC -- 특이사항 FROM CRM_CUST_MGT A LEFT OUTER JOIN CRM_CUST_OPERATE_INFO B ON A.SEQ = B.SEQ LEFT OUTER JOIN CRM_CUST_PROJECT_MGT C ON A.SEQ = C.SEQ where A.CRM_CODE IN (${crmList}) ) IN_TB ORDER BY RNUM DESC

SELECT TB1.* ,NVL(TB2.ANSWER_CNT,0) AS ANSWER_CNT ,ROUND(C005 / TB1.TOT * 100,2) AS AS_RATE ,ROUND(NVL(TB2.ANSWER_CNT,0) / TB1.TOT * 100,2) AS ANSWER_RATE FROM ( SELECT ASSIGN_ID ,(SELECT EMP_NM FROM CRM_EMP_MGT WHERE EMP_NO = ASSIGN_ID) AS ASSIGN_NM ,COUNT(PROC_STATUS) AS TOT ,SUM(CASE PROC_STATUS WHEN 'C002' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS C002 ,SUM(CASE PROC_STATUS WHEN 'C003' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS C003 ,SUM(CASE PROC_STATUS WHEN 'C004' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS C004 ,SUM(CASE PROC_STATUS WHEN 'C005' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS C005 FROM CRM_AS_MGT WHERE PROC_STATUS IN ('C002','C003','C004','C005') AND DEL_YN IS NULL AND ASSIGN_ID IN (SELECT EMP_NO FROM CRM_EMP_MGT) AND ACCEPT_DT IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(ACCEPT_DT) = 8 AND (TO_DATE(ACCEPT_DT,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{search_start} || '000000','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(#{search_end} || '235959','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) GROUP BY ASSIGN_ID ) TB1 , ( SELECT ASSIGN_ID, SUM(DECODE(CNT,0,0,1)) AS ANSWER_CNT FROM ( SELECT A.ASSIGN_ID, COUNT(A.AS_NO) AS CNT FROM CRM_AS_MGT A, CRM_AS_MGT_ANSWER B WHERE A.PROC_STATUS IN ('C002','C003','C004','C005') AND A.DEL_YN IS NULL AND ACCEPT_DT IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(ACCEPT_DT) = 8 AND (TO_DATE(ACCEPT_DT,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{search_start} || '000000','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(#{search_end} || '235959','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) AND A.AS_NO = B.AS_NO AND A.ASSIGN_ID = B.W_ID GROUP BY ASSIGN_ID, A.AS_NO ) GROUP BY ASSIGN_ID ) TB2 WHERE TB1.ASSIGN_ID = TB2.ASSIGN_ID(+) ORDER BY TB1.ASSIGN_NM

SELECT TB1.* ,NVL(TB2.ANSWER_CNT,0) AS ANSWER_CNT ,ROUND(NVL(TB2.ANSWER_CNT,0) / TB1.TOT * 100,2) AS ANSWER_RATE FROM ( SELECT ASSIGN_ID ,(SELECT EMP_NM FROM CRM_EMP_MGT WHERE EMP_NO = ASSIGN_ID) AS ASSIGN_NM ,COUNT(ACCEPT_ROUTE) AS TOT ${col_str} FROM CRM_AS_MGT WHERE ACCEPT_ROUTE IN (SELECT CODE FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL WHERE CODE_GROUP='AS' AND P_CODE='CD02') AND DEL_YN IS NULL AND ASSIGN_ID IN (SELECT EMP_NO FROM CRM_EMP_MGT) AND ACCEPT_DT IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(ACCEPT_DT) = 8 AND (TO_DATE(ACCEPT_DT,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{search_start} || '000000','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(#{search_end} || '235959','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) GROUP BY ASSIGN_ID ) TB1 , ( SELECT ASSIGN_ID, SUM(DECODE(CNT,0,0,1)) AS ANSWER_CNT FROM ( SELECT A.ASSIGN_ID, COUNT(A.AS_NO) AS CNT FROM CRM_AS_MGT A, CRM_AS_MGT_ANSWER B WHERE ACCEPT_ROUTE IN (SELECT CODE FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL WHERE CODE_GROUP='AS' AND P_CODE='CD02') AND A.DEL_YN IS NULL AND ACCEPT_DT IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(ACCEPT_DT) = 8 AND (TO_DATE(ACCEPT_DT,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{search_start} || '000000','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(#{search_end} || '235959','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) AND A.AS_NO = B.AS_NO AND A.ASSIGN_ID = B.W_ID GROUP BY ASSIGN_ID, A.AS_NO ) GROUP BY ASSIGN_ID ) TB2 WHERE TB1.ASSIGN_ID = TB2.ASSIGN_ID(+) ORDER BY TB1.ASSIGN_NM

SELECT TB1.* ,NVL(TB2.ANSWER_CNT,0) AS ANSWER_CNT ,ROUND(NVL(TB2.ANSWER_CNT,0) / TB1.TOT * 100,2) AS ANSWER_RATE FROM ( SELECT ASSIGN_ID ,(SELECT EMP_NM FROM CRM_EMP_MGT WHERE EMP_NO = ASSIGN_ID) AS ASSIGN_NM ,COUNT(SERVICE_CATE) AS TOT ${col_str} FROM CRM_AS_MGT WHERE SERVICE_CATE in (SELECT CODE FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL WHERE CODE_GROUP='AS' AND P_CODE='CD03') AND DEL_YN IS NULL AND ASSIGN_ID IN (SELECT EMP_NO FROM CRM_EMP_MGT) AND ACCEPT_DT IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(ACCEPT_DT) = 8 AND (TO_DATE(ACCEPT_DT,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{search_start} || '000000','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(#{search_end} || '235959','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) GROUP BY ASSIGN_ID ) TB1 , ( SELECT ASSIGN_ID, SUM(DECODE(CNT,0,0,1)) AS ANSWER_CNT FROM ( SELECT A.ASSIGN_ID, COUNT(A.AS_NO) AS CNT FROM CRM_AS_MGT A, CRM_AS_MGT_ANSWER B WHERE SERVICE_CATE in (SELECT CODE FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL WHERE CODE_GROUP='AS' AND P_CODE='CD03') AND A.DEL_YN IS NULL AND ACCEPT_DT IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(ACCEPT_DT) = 8 AND (TO_DATE(ACCEPT_DT,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{search_start} || '000000','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(#{search_end} || '235959','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) AND A.AS_NO = B.AS_NO AND A.ASSIGN_ID = B.W_ID GROUP BY ASSIGN_ID, A.AS_NO ) GROUP BY ASSIGN_ID ) TB2 WHERE TB1.ASSIGN_ID = TB2.ASSIGN_ID(+) ORDER BY TB1.ASSIGN_NM

SELECT TB1.* ,NVL(TB2.ANSWER_CNT,0) AS ANSWER_CNT ,ROUND(NVL(TB2.ANSWER_CNT,0) / TB1.TOT * 100,2) AS ANSWER_RATE FROM ( SELECT ASSIGN_ID ,(SELECT EMP_NM FROM CRM_EMP_MGT WHERE EMP_NO = ASSIGN_ID) AS ASSIGN_NM ,COUNT(CAUSE_TYPE) AS TOT ${col_str} FROM CRM_AS_MGT WHERE CAUSE_TYPE IN (SELECT CODE FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL WHERE USE_YN='Y' AND CODE_GROUP = 'AS' AND P_CODE='CD05') AND DEL_YN IS NULL AND ASSIGN_ID IN (SELECT EMP_NO FROM CRM_EMP_MGT) AND ACCEPT_DT IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(ACCEPT_DT) = 8 AND (TO_DATE(ACCEPT_DT,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{search_start} || '000000','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(#{search_end} || '235959','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) GROUP BY ASSIGN_ID ) TB1 , ( SELECT ASSIGN_ID, SUM(DECODE(CNT,0,0,1)) AS ANSWER_CNT FROM ( SELECT A.ASSIGN_ID, COUNT(A.AS_NO) AS CNT FROM CRM_AS_MGT A, CRM_AS_MGT_ANSWER B WHERE CAUSE_TYPE IN (SELECT CODE FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL WHERE USE_YN='Y' AND CODE_GROUP = 'AS' AND P_CODE='CD05') AND A.DEL_YN IS NULL AND ACCEPT_DT IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(ACCEPT_DT) = 8 AND (TO_DATE(ACCEPT_DT,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{search_start} || '000000','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(#{search_end} || '235959','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) AND A.AS_NO = B.AS_NO AND A.ASSIGN_ID = B.W_ID GROUP BY ASSIGN_ID, A.AS_NO ) GROUP BY ASSIGN_ID ) TB2 WHERE TB1.ASSIGN_ID = TB2.ASSIGN_ID(+) ORDER BY TB1.ASSIGN_NM

SELECT TB1.* ,NVL(TB2.ANSWER_CNT,0) AS ANSWER_CNT ,ROUND(NVL(TB2.ANSWER_CNT,0) / TB1.TOT * 100,2) AS ANSWER_RATE FROM ( SELECT ASSIGN_ID ,(SELECT EMP_NM FROM CRM_EMP_MGT WHERE EMP_NO = ASSIGN_ID) AS ASSIGN_NM ,COUNT(ACTION_TYPE) AS TOT ${col_str} FROM CRM_AS_MGT WHERE ACTION_TYPE IN (SELECT CODE FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL WHERE USE_YN='Y' AND CODE_GROUP = 'AS' AND P_CODE='CD06') AND DEL_YN IS NULL AND ASSIGN_ID IN (SELECT EMP_NO FROM CRM_EMP_MGT) AND ACCEPT_DT IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(ACCEPT_DT) = 8 AND (TO_DATE(ACCEPT_DT,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{search_start} || '000000','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(#{search_end} || '235959','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) GROUP BY ASSIGN_ID ) TB1 , ( SELECT ASSIGN_ID, SUM(DECODE(CNT,0,0,1)) AS ANSWER_CNT FROM ( SELECT A.ASSIGN_ID, COUNT(A.AS_NO) AS CNT FROM CRM_AS_MGT A, CRM_AS_MGT_ANSWER B WHERE ACTION_TYPE IN (SELECT CODE FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL WHERE USE_YN='Y' AND CODE_GROUP = 'AS' AND P_CODE='CD06') AND A.DEL_YN IS NULL AND A.ACCEPT_DT IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(A.ACCEPT_DT) = 8 AND (TO_DATE(A.ACCEPT_DT,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{search_start} || '000000','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(#{search_end} || '235959','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) AND A.AS_NO = B.AS_NO AND A.ASSIGN_ID = B.W_ID GROUP BY ASSIGN_ID, A.AS_NO ) GROUP BY ASSIGN_ID ) TB2 WHERE TB1.ASSIGN_ID = TB2.ASSIGN_ID(+) ORDER BY TB1.ASSIGN_NM

SELECT TB1.* ,(SELECT MAX(Z.CUST_KOR_NAME) FROM CRM_CUST_MGT Z WHERE Z.CRM_CODE = TB1.CUST_CODE) AS CUST_NM FROM ( SELECT CUST_CODE ,COUNT(ACCEPT_ROUTE) AS TOT ${col_str} FROM CRM_AS_MGT WHERE ACCEPT_ROUTE IN (SELECT CODE FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL WHERE CODE_GROUP='AS' AND P_CODE='CD01') AND DEL_YN IS NULL AND CUST_CODE IN (SELECT CRM_CODE FROM CRM_CUST_MGT) AND ACCEPT_DT IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(ACCEPT_DT) = 8 AND (TO_DATE(ACCEPT_DT,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{search_start} || '000000','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(#{search_end} || '235959','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) GROUP BY CUST_CODE ) TB1 ORDER BY CUST_NM

SELECT TB1.* ,(SELECT MAX(Z.CUST_KOR_NAME) FROM CRM_CUST_MGT Z WHERE Z.CRM_CODE = TB1.CUST_CODE) AS CUST_NM FROM ( SELECT CUST_CODE ,COUNT(ACCEPT_ROUTE) AS TOT ${col_str} FROM CRM_AS_MGT WHERE ACCEPT_ROUTE IN (SELECT CODE FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL WHERE CODE_GROUP='AS' AND P_CODE='CD02') AND DEL_YN IS NULL AND CUST_CODE IN (SELECT CRM_CODE FROM CRM_CUST_MGT) AND ACCEPT_DT IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(ACCEPT_DT) = 8 AND (TO_DATE(ACCEPT_DT,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{search_start} || '000000','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(#{search_end} || '235959','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) GROUP BY CUST_CODE ) TB1 ORDER BY CUST_NM

SELECT TB1.* ,(SELECT MAX(Z.CUST_KOR_NAME) FROM CRM_CUST_MGT Z WHERE Z.CRM_CODE = TB1.CUST_CODE) AS CUST_NM FROM ( SELECT CUST_CODE ,COUNT(SERVICE_CATE) AS TOT ${col_str} FROM CRM_AS_MGT WHERE SERVICE_CATE in (SELECT CODE FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL WHERE CODE_GROUP='AS' AND P_CODE='CD03') AND DEL_YN IS NULL AND CUST_CODE IN (SELECT CRM_CODE FROM CRM_CUST_MGT) AND ACCEPT_DT IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(ACCEPT_DT) = 8 AND (TO_DATE(ACCEPT_DT,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{search_start} || '000000','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(#{search_end} || '235959','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) GROUP BY CUST_CODE ) TB1 ORDER BY CUST_NM

SELECT 'SUM(DECODE(ACCEPT_DT,'''|| YYYYMM ||''',1,0)) AS M' || YYYYMM || '' AS COLS , 'M'||YYYYMM||'' AS FIELDNAME , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(YYYYMM,'YYYYMM'),'YYYY/MM') AS LABEL FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{search_start},'YYYYMM'),LEVEL-1),'YYYYMM') AS YYYYMM FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= (SELECT MONTHS_BETWEEN(TO_DATE(#{search_end},'YYYYMM'), TO_DATE(#{search_start},'YYYYMM')) + 1 FROM DUAL) )

SELECT 'SUM(DECODE(ACCEPT_DT,'''|| YYYYMMDD ||''',1,0)) AS M'||YYYYMMDD||'' AS COLS , 'M'||YYYYMMDD||'' AS FIELDNAME , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(YYYYMMDD,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') AS LABEL FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR((TO_DATE(#{search_start},'YYYYMMDD') + LEVEL-1),'YYYYMMDD') AS YYYYMMDD FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= (SELECT (TO_DATE(#{search_end},'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(#{search_start},'YYYYMMDD')) + 1 FROM DUAL) )
